title: The Coup
description: Brenner has moved. Tanks in Ashenmere at 03:41. Dusek called with a warning. You have hours to decide — flee, negotiate, or fight.

title: The Military Rallies
description: Three thousand soldiers on the parade ground. The military has chosen its side — yours. What you say to them now defines what that loyalty means.

title: Budget Allocation — Emergency Powers
description: Whether you're facing a coup or rallying the military, the budget needs emergency adjustment. The treasury can't wait for the political situation to stabilize.

title: Brenner — Face to Face
description: Brenner has requested a direct meeting. Not through aides — through a handwritten note delivered by a captain who waited for your response. Whatever he wants to say, he doesn't want intermediaries.

title: International Broadcast — Your Voice
description: The International Forum has offered you a broadcast slot. The world is watching. What you say in the next ten minutes will be the headline in every capital that matters.

title: The Residence — Family Under Threat
description: If the coup succeeds, your family is in danger. If it fails, they've still spent a night wondering whether tanks would reach the residence. Either way, they need you more than the country does right now.
